full_prompt_en: A close dark-fantasy anime portrait fills a tall frame with the face and shoulders of a pale-haired young man. Thick white and smoky blue-gray bangs drop across one eye, while the exposed eye glows a narrow red beneath a dark lid. His expression is a restrained, unsettling half smile, with fine teeth catching small cold highlights. Several short scratchlike marks cross the cheek. One side of the face remains pale and smoothly modeled; the other is overwhelmed by red-black shadow and rough streaks, creating an unstable split across the nose and mouth. A dark jacket and light collar appear only at the bottom, partly lost in the painterly noise. The background is a flat but damaged scarlet field, scraped with charcoal, teal, and orange marks that merge with the edges of hair and clothing. The composition crops tightly above the head and below the shoulders so the asymmetrical eyes, mouth, and color split dominate. Fine anime linework controls the eye, jaw, and individual hair tips, but the larger surface is loose and aggressive: vertical dry-brush scrapes, splatters, and ragged paint patches create a distressed mixed-media finish. Saturated red occupies broad areas; black and deep teal form the principal shadow mass; white hair and pale skin provide sharp light. A few golden-orange flecks spark near the shadow side. Lighting is dramatic but graphic, with the visible eye and teeth brightened against a nearly black socket and jaw. The resulting image feels tense and psychologically charged, its beauty disrupted by the collision of clean facial drawing and abrasive color texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅暗黑奇幻动漫近景以脸和肩填满高画幅，描绘一名浅发年轻男子。浓厚白色与烟蓝灰色刘海垂过一只眼，露出的眼在深眼皮下闪出一线红光。表情是克制而不安的半笑，细牙接住几处冷亮高光。几道短划痕横过脸颊。脸的一侧仍苍白且平滑塑形；另一侧被红黑阴影与粗糙条痕淹没，在鼻与嘴上形成不稳定对分。深色外套与浅领只在底部显露，部分消失于绘画噪点中。背景是平坦却受损的猩红色域，炭黑、青绿与橙色刮痕混入发丝和衣物边缘。构图在头上和肩下紧裁切，使不对称双眼、嘴和颜色分割占主导。细动漫线条控制眼、下颌与独立发梢，但大面积表面松散而激烈：竖向干笔刮擦、泼点和毛糙颜料斑块形成磨损混合媒介饰面。饱和红占据宽大区域；黑和深青绿形成主要阴影块；白发与浅肤提供尖锐亮部。几粒金橙细点在阴影侧闪烁。光线戏剧性强却图形化，显露的眼与牙在近黑眼窝和下颌中被点亮。画面紧张、心理气息浓重，干净脸部素描与磨蚀色彩纹理的碰撞打断其美感。
style_prompt_en: Dark anime-inflected mixed-media painting combines fine controlled linear detail with abrasive broad color texture. Large fields of scarlet, near-black, and deep teal collide with pale cream and cool white accents. One side of a focal form remains smoothly modeled while the opposite side breaks into dry-brush scrapes, vertical smears, splatter, and ragged paint fragments. Thin sharp lines pick out selected interior edges, contrasting with frayed transitions where form dissolves into the ground. Tight cropping magnifies asymmetry and keeps attention on a few small luminous red and silver points. Light is graphic and high contrast, leaving deep cavities almost black while allowing pale planes to glow softly. The background has little spatial depth; it behaves as a distressed painted sheet that invades the foreground. The rhythm alternates precise small marks with rough sweeping strokes, making the image tense, vivid, and slightly unstable.
style_prompt_zh: 受暗黑动漫影响的混合媒介绘画把细致受控线性细节与磨蚀性宽色纹理结合。猩红、近黑与深青绿的大色域撞上浅奶油和冷白重点。焦点形体一侧保持平滑塑形，另一侧裂成干笔刮痕、竖向抹擦、泼点与毛糙颜料碎片。纤细锐线拣出精选内部边缘，对位形体溶入底面处的散毛过渡。紧裁切放大不对称，把注意集中到少量发亮红点与银点。光图形化且高反差，让深凹近乎黑色，同时使浅平面柔和发光。背景空间深度很少；它像磨损彩绘薄片侵入前景。节奏在精确小笔点与粗糙横扫笔痕之间交替，使图像紧张、鲜明并略显不稳定。
theme_en: A pale-haired dark fantasy character smiles faintly against a scarlet distressed ground
theme_zh: 灰白发暗黑幻想人物在猩红磨损背景前微笑
name: Tokyo Ghoul
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
